name: EGNN
tagline: E(n)-equivariant GNN using only pairwise distances as edge features for ligand-pocket message passing.
pseudocode:
1. Embed ligand and pocket atoms: $h_l = W_l x_l$, $h_p = W_p x_p$.
2. Use distance scalars $d_{ij}$ as edge features (1-dim).
3. For each layer $\ell=1..L$:
   a. EGNN message: $m_{ij} = \phi_u(h_i) + \phi_v(h_j) + \phi_e(d_{ij})$.
   b. Aggregate $a_j = \sum_{i \in \mathcal{N}(j)} m_{ij}$ over CIG (intra) and NIG (inter) edges.
   c. Update $h_j' = \psi(\text{cat}[h_j, a_j])$; sum across edge types.
4. Score atom-atom interactions for both L$\to$P and P$\to$L; subtract attention-pooled bias.
5. Return $(\hat{y}_{lp} + \hat{y}_{pl}) / 2$.
diff_from_baseline: Satorras et al. 2021 (E(n) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks). Equivariant message passing using pairwise distances; here adapted to a heterogeneous CIG/NIG graph following EHIGN_PLA/ablation_study/HEGNN.

name: EHIGN
tagline: Edge-enhanced Heterogeneous Interaction GNN with covalent (CIG) and non-covalent (NIG) convolutions and dual bidirectional readout.
pseudocode:
1. Embed nodes ($h_l$, $h_p$) and 4 edge types ($e_{ll}, e_{pp}, e_{lp}, e_{pl}$) to dim $H$.
2. For each layer $\ell=1..L$:
   a. CIGConv (intra): $\text{MLP}(h + \sum_{i \in \mathcal{N}} \text{ReLU}(h_i + e_i))$.
   b. NIGConv (inter): edge-weighted gated aggregation $W_n \frac{1}{|\mathcal{N}|}\sum h_i \odot w_i + W_s h_j$.
   c. HeteroGraphConv: sum intra and inter outputs per node type.
3. Two atom-atom heads: $\hat{y}_{lp}, \hat{y}_{pl}$ from $W_e e \odot W_s h_i \odot W_d h_j$ pooled via inter-batch.
4. Attention-based bias correction subtracted from each head; average $(\hat{y}_{lp} + \hat{y}_{pl})/2$.
5. Loss = $\frac{1}{3}(\text{MSE}(\hat{y}_{lp}, y) + \text{MSE}(\hat{y}_{pl}, y) + \text{MSE}(\hat{y}_{lp}, \hat{y}_{pl}))$.
diff_from_baseline: Yang et al. (guaguabujianle/EHIGN_PLA). Heterogeneous interaction GNN designed specifically for protein-ligand affinity, with bidirectional dual prediction and consistency regularization.

name: GIGN
tagline: Geometric Interaction GNN: GIN-style message passing for ligand and pocket plus an inter-edge readout head.
pseudocode:
1. Embed atoms: $h_l = W_l x_l$, $h_p = W_p x_p$ to dim $H$.
2. For each layer $\ell=1..L$:
   a. GINLayer (intra): $h' = \text{MLP}((1+\epsilon) h + \sum_i (h_i + W_e e_i))$ for ligand and pocket.
   b. InterGINLayer (L$\to$P): mean-aggregated ligand messages concatenated with pocket and passed through MLP.
3. Inter-edge readout: $\text{MLP}(\text{cat}[h_l[s], h_p[d], e_{lp}])$ summed per complex.
4. Graph readout: $\text{MLP}(\text{cat}[\text{mean}(h_l), \text{mean}(h_p)])$.
5. Return $(\text{inter\_pred} + \text{graph\_pred}) / 2$.
diff_from_baseline: Yang et al. 2023 (guaguabujianle/GIGN). Geometric interaction graph network using GIN message passing on heterogeneous protein-ligand graphs; combines edge-level and graph-level affinity prediction.

name: SchNet
tagline: Continuous-filter convolution with Gaussian RBF distance expansion applied to all heterogeneous edge types.
pseudocode:
1. Expand pairwise distances with RBFs: $\phi_k(d) = \exp(-(d - \mu_k)^2 / (2\sigma^2))$, $k=1..60$ on $[0, 6]$Å.
2. Embed atoms: $h_l = W_l x_l$, $h_p = W_p x_p$ to dim $H$.
3. For each layer $\ell=1..L$:
   a. CFConv: $h_j' = h_j + \text{MLP}(\sum_{i \in \mathcal{N}(j)} W_n h_i \odot \text{filter}(\phi(d_{ij})))$.
   b. Apply CFConv on ligand-ligand, pocket-pocket, ligand$\to$pocket, pocket$\to$ligand.
   c. Sum per-node-type outputs (HeteroGraphConv).
4. Atom-atom heads + attention bias correction; return mean of L$\to$P and P$\to$L predictions.
diff_from_baseline: Schütt et al. 2017 (NeurIPS). Continuous-filter convolutional network using Gaussian RBF distance featurization; here adapted to a heterogeneous CIG/NIG protein-ligand graph following EHIGN_PLA/ablation_study/HSchNet.
